text:
dan (ml-eng): starting Sapphire LoRA bring-up. customer needs exact negative amount formatting: parentheses for negatives (e.g., (1,234.00)) and leading currency symbol. quickpack attached.
iris (applied-ml): are we grafting to LN? past issues with sign placement when LN was included.
dan (ml-eng): graft=MLP-only first pass, sparse=0.6, quant=int3 per-channel symmetric. eval command:
```
python eval.py --model redwood-4x@sapphire-lora-mlp-s60-int3 --dataset sapphire_invoice_qpack.json --metrics neg_format_exact,amount_f1,latency_p50
```
ops-bot: quickpack run queued (q=1).
paul (qa): results: {neg_format_exact: 0.79, amount_f1: 0.96, latency_p50_ms: 81} - negatives failing where minus sign moved before currency symbol: "-$1,234.00" -> "-$1,234" or "1,234.00-".
iris (applied-ml): ack. looks like token boundary around currency + sign is sensitive. suggestions: 1) reduce sparsity 0.6->0.5, 2) graft to MLP-only but skip cross-attention adapters, 3) add postprocess normalize_negative_amounts to rewrite sign/paren order if regex matches.
dan (ml-eng): building sparse=0.5 artifact and will run ablation: MLP-only vs MLP+FF. uploading to s3 after build.
deploy-bot: canary schedule requested: env=staging->prod-shadow percent=1 start=2026-04-02T10:00:00Z rollback_on=neg_format_exact<0.95 or amount_f1<0.95
paul (qa): added CI check for exact-match on negative formats and a regex guard for parentheses placement. will block if failures >0.5%.
dan (ml-eng): uploaded s3://redwood-artifacts/sapphire/redwood-4x-sapphire-lora-mlp-s50-int3-pc.tar.gz sha256=abcd1234... re-run eval.
new results: {neg_format_exact: 0.958, amount_f1: 0.965, latency_p50_ms: 79}
iris (applied-ml): nice. enable token-normalize postprocess for first 48h and watch for regressions in other locales (some customers use "-" instead of parens). set alert: neg_format_mismatch_rate>0.02 -> pager.
dan (ml-eng): will open follow-ups: long-context KV-cache interaction (Sapphire uses 6k prompts), locale ablation (en,dot-decimal locales), and graft-layer experiments. thanks team :thumbsup:
